items.rationale: The claim is explicitly bounded to the frozen 12-record set and specifies the material comparison needed to refute the asserted gap. The packet's screening result reports that no included record described all of the required same-backbone, same-task, same-budget, paired gate/no-gate, immediate-pre-delivery conditions, while its limitations prevent expansion into a universal novelty claim.
decisive_evidence: screening_result: Among the 12 included records, end-to-end agent papers and claim/citation-verification papers occurred as separate groups; no screening record described all of same backbone, same task, same budget, paired gate/no-gate paths, and immediate pre-delivery placement.
limitations: absence from this set is not evidence that no prior work exists
